results.name: Athanor's OpenMM set-up gives AMBER's energies for the same coordinates (OL15 + GBn2, 150 mM): every term equal to the same force field read from tleap's prmtop (0.01 kcal/mol), and within 0.05% of sander's
results.detail: totals: Athanor -5409.19, prmtop -5409.09, sander -5410.21 kcal/mol; largest term difference from prmtop 0.0002 kcal/mol, from sander 0.017%

results.name: in dynamics the dodecamer stays close to its NMR solution structure (central 8 bp, heavy atoms; median RMSD over the production run <= 2.5 A)
results.detail: median 1.48 A, 90th percentile 1.83 A over 100 frames (500 ps); to the crystal (355D): median 1.63 A

results.name: average helix twist and rise of the central 8 bp match the NMR structure (within 2.5 deg and 0.2 A)
results.detail: twist 33.95 vs 35.48 deg; rise 3.353 vs 3.179 A (crystal 355D: 33.57 deg, 3.236 A)
